subject: CAIQ annotated index + evidence handshake for Avalon Health security review
messages:
From: James Lee <james.lee@avalonhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Avalon Health Security <security@avalonhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ request for Redwood - mapping + evidence

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the meeting earlier this week. Avalon Health is running a security gating for our pilot and we need a CAIQ-style control mapping against your environment and a list of evidence artifacts for the controls called out. Specifically we need:

- A one-page control index showing which CSA CAIQ questions map to Redwood controls and the artifact name/location for each (PDF/Drive links are fine).
- Samples of audit/log evidence for inference requests and admin activity (redacted is fine).
- Confirmation on where encryption-at-rest keys are managed and the control owner.

Can we get an initial package by next Wednesday (Jun 2)? If there are any limitations (e.g., PII in logs) let us know up front.

Appreciate it —
James
James Lee
Security Architect, Avalon Health
security@avalonhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: James Lee <james.lee@avalonhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ request for Redwood - mapping + evidence

Hi James —

Thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We can put together an annotated CAIQ index and a short evidence bundle by Jun 2 with the following plan:

1) Deliverable: "redwood_caiq_index_v0.1.xlsx" — row per CAIQ question with control mapping, evidence filename, and owner.
2) Evidence: redacted audit/log sample + control artifacts (policy, runbook excerpts). If logs contain customer data we will provide redacted exports.
3) Point of contact: Monica (Security) will own the mapping; Lauren will own logistics and handoff. Vivek will confirm key-management details.

I attached the initial index template and our control-ownership roster so you can see the proposed owners. If that layout works we will populate and send the bundle by EOD Jun 2 (we may push earlier for ones you flagged as high-priority).

Next steps: can you confirm the scope (Do you want only controls related to data-inference and storage, or full CAIQ?) and whether you need signed attestations?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_caiq_index_v0.1.xlsx, control-ownership-roster.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
To: James Lee <james.lee@avalonhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ request for Redwood - mapping + evidence

Hi James —

Thanks — scope clarification: to save time we recommend focusing the initial pass on the CAIQ domains most relevant to SaaS inference:

- Data Security & Privacy (DS)
- Audit & Accountability (AU)
- Identity & Access Management (IAM)
- Infrastructure & Virtualization (IV)

We will annotate all CAIQ questions in those domains and provide a short evidence index. For your logs request: we can provide a redacted sampling showing request IDs, timestamps, and action (inference request vs admin change). We will not include PII; where request payloads could contain customer PII we will show metadata only.

Owners and ETA:
- Monica: control annotations + evidence selection (ETA: Jun 2, 4pm PT)
- Vivek: encryption key custody and KMS diagrams (ETA: Jun 2 morning)
- Lauren: packaging + secure transfer (Doc/Drive link + short checklist)

Would you like a short phone call Monday morning to review the index layout?

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: James Lee <james.lee@avalonhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Avalon Health Security <security@avalonhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ request for Redwood - mapping + evidence

Monica / Ben —

That scope looks good. Two quick clarifications before you assemble the bundle: 

1) For the audit sample, does the log capture the inference model identifier and the customer account id (or at least a hashed id)? Our compliance team needs to trace actions back to accounts.
2) For KMS, please indicate whether keys are customer-managed (bring-your-own-key) for private deployments, or Redwood-managed for hosted customers. A one-line statement per deployment mode is fine.

I can do a 20-minute call Monday 8:30am PT if that helps.

Thanks,
James

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: James Lee <james.lee@avalonhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ request for Redwood - mapping + evidence

James —

Short answers inline and attaching the package we discussed.

1) Audit sample: Yes — our request audit includes model identifier and a tenancy/account alias. To protect customer data we will provide a redacted sample with a hashed account id column and the model_id column. See attached logs_sample_202705.zip for the CSV extract (redaction applied).

2) KMS by deployment: 
- Hosted (Redwood API): Redwood-managed keys by default (we store DEKs encrypted with a customer-isolated master in our KMS); customers can request a dedicated key per contract.
- Dedicated: Customer key-integration available; we support external KMS for Dedicated clusters via our KMS bridge.
- Private/VPC/on-prem: BYOK supported; customers retain control of the master keys.

Attachments included: redwood_caiq_index_v0.1.xlsx (completed annotations), control-ownership-roster.pdf (owners and contact), evidence_transfer_playbook.docx (transfer checklist + secure link rules), logs_sample_202705.zip (redacted CSV). We uploaded the same bundle to a secure Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A-example-caiq-evidence

If that looks good we can schedule a short call to walk through the index and answer specific control questions.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
